model.description: Shared refuseIfVacuous(value,{name,expect}): {ok:false,reason} | {ok:true} called at the TOP of every guard. Returns a NAMED refusal or ok. ONE helper, ONE place, reused (DRY) - kills the vacuous-truth silent-pass by construction. INV-C3-1/2/3. R-C3.
